title.zh: 修订第 1018 号共和国法（题为《授予 Ang Tibay，Inc. 在菲律宾境内建设、维护和运营私人固定点对点及陆基、陆上移动无线电台的临时许可的法案》）
title.en: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Ten Hundred Eighteen, Entitled “An Act Granting the Ang Tibay, Inc. a Temporary Permit to Construct, Maintain and Operate Private Fixed Point-to-Point and Land Based and Land Mobile Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines
title.orig: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Ten Hundred Eighteen, Entitled “An Act Granting the Ang Tibay, Inc. a Temporary Permit to Construct, Maintain and Operate Private Fixed Point-to-Point and Land Based and Land Mobile Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3133_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section one of Republic Act Numbered Ten hundred eighteen is amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. There is hereby granted to the Ang Tibay, Inc., its successors or assigns, a franchise to construct, maintain and operate in the Philippines, at such places as the said corporation may select, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications, private fixed point-to-point and land based and land mobile radio stations for the reception and transmission of wireless messages on radiotelegraphy or radiotelephony, each station to be provided with radio transmitting apparatus and a radio receiving apparatus."
Section two of the same Act is repealed.

Section three of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 3. The grantee, its successors or assigns, shall not engage in domestic business of telecommunications in the Philippines, it being understood that the purpose of this franchise is to secure to the grantee the right to construct, install, maintain and operate private fixed point-to-point and land based and land mobile radio stations in such places within the Philippines as the interest of the grantee may justify."

Section ten of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 10. This franchise shall be subject to amendment, alteration or repeal by the Congress of the Philippines when the public interest so requires, and shall not be interpreted as an exclusive grant of the privilege herein provided for."

The title of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"An Act granting the Ang Tibay, Inc., a franchise to construct, maintain and operate private fixed point-to-point and land based and land mobile radio stations for the reception and transmission of radio communications within the Philippines."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
